SRC-215:R001.text: Investigate the stated systemic-availability hypotheses without presuming defect; distinguish correct, avoidable, recoverable and incorrect refusals using current authoritative source and evidence.

SRC-215:R002.text: Audit SAI_WEBSITE T-31 and reported E-336 through E-354 against the actual runtime contract; preserve the distinction between consumer observations and proven upstream root cause, with unavailable original evidence explicitly unresolved.

SRC-215:R003.text: Corroborate incident families A-E from original evidence: bounded continuation, ownership contention, runtime/skill mismatch, recovery/evidence reachability and global versus scoped stopping; otherwise mark them unproven.

SRC-215:R004.text: Deliver all twelve blocker taxonomy classes. For each state the operation that stops, independent allowed operations, permitted recovery, retained evidence, genuine human requirement, automatic retry conditions and authority or duplicate-effect risk.

SRC-215:R005.text: Evaluate NORMAL, DEGRADED, QUARANTINED and HARD_STOP; verify ticket-level isolation, safe engineering without lifecycle admission and possible narrower locks while preserving provenance, concurrency, authorization and integrity.
